snippet.title: Forest Asylum 2 - Announcement Trailer/Teaser
snippet.description:
Forest Asylum 2 - An Indie Psychological Horror Game.
Embark on a Therapy That Will Change Your Life!
Wishlist now on Steam! Demo version is out now!

#indiegame #indiegames #indiegamedev #indiegamedevelopment #horrorgame #horrorgames 

First announcement Trailer/Teaser of the well-received first part.

After the events of the first game, the player enters therapy to process their trauma. Upon arriving at the asylum, things don't go according to plan. A storm and the resulting power outage lead to events that will change their life forever.

Will you manage to escape the asylum alive? Or will you perish in a dark corner of the asylum's basement...
